title: Party Crashers
summary: Party Crashers brings Lagos events into one place, helping people find a gathering without piecing together scattered flyers and organizer posts. Explore events, save a plan and share an event of your own.
role: Product concept, brand direction, interface design and full-stack development.
built: Event discovery and search, event details, saved plans and free event submissions.

title: Fieldmark
summary: A real estate identity built around good homes and clear decisions. Strategy, naming, an architectural logo and a complete visual system across print and digital.
role: Brand strategy, naming, visual identity, art direction and brand guidelines.
built: Logo system, colours, typography, property campaigns, stationery, social and digital mockups.

title: SplitHouse
summary: SplitHouse addresses the mental work of sharing a home: remembering who paid, who owes and whose turn it is. Shared expenses, chores and household members sit together in a welcoming interface.
role: Product design, front-end and backend development, authentication and deployment.
built: Google and email sign-in, household setup, shared expenses, chores, people and persistent theme preference.

title: Bordeaux Nail Studio
summary: An immersive beauty studio concept with burgundy art direction, a dreamy cloud doorway and editorial imagery. Visitors choose a service and preferred time, then continue their booking request directly in WhatsApp.
role: Design, development, motion and AI art direction.
built: Responsive layout, animated transitions, service selection and WhatsApp request preparation.

title: Moremi
summary: Moremi helps children move from consuming content to creating small working apps. Guided starters let a child change a rule, predict what happens, test it and keep the creation.
role: Founder, learning experience designer and product developer.
built: Two playable projects in the current development build: Puff-puff Counter and Market Stall. Guided editing, prediction, tests, saving and remixing. Research direction: ages 8–12, phone-first and offline-first; the remaining curriculum is in development.

title: Cutout
summary: A free background removal tool that runs on the user’s device. The experience keeps the task straightforward: bring an image, remove the background and use the result.
built: Browser-based AI background removal with no signup required. Portfolio visual: generated interface mockup.

title: ProofRoom
summary: ProofRoom addresses feedback scattered across messages and versions. Artwork, pinned comments, revisions and approval live in one review workspace. The current build uses a private workspace in each browser; shared team review is a future step.
role: Product design, onboarding, front-end development, Supabase backend and Vercel deployment.
built: Persistent projects and feedback, private image storage, revision history, approval controls, onboarding and light/dark mode. Portfolio visual: generated interface mockup.

title: Suya & Smoke
summary: A restaurant website demo with bold visual direction, a menu and WhatsApp ordering. A configurable kit designed to adapt to another restaurant’s brand.
built: Menu presentation, location information and WhatsApp order journey.

title: CarryGo
summary: An expressive Lagos delivery concept that makes a journey legible, from pickup to drop-off. Its route study lets visitors explore an illustrative trip across the city
built: Responsive React experience, route selector and motion-led storytelling.

title: Kolo
summary: A landing page for a smart savings app. Clear messaging and a strong product showcase introduce the app and help visitors understand its purpose quickly.
built: Product landing page, feature presentation and responsive layouts.

title: Mide Alabi
summary: A photographer portfolio that lets the photography lead. The page frames the work with expressive typography and an editorial visual direction.
built: Photography-led layout, project presentation and responsive browsing.

title: KwikFlow
summary: A plumbing and home services website built around the customer’s need to find help quickly. The brand and service information support a clear enquiry journey.
built: Service information, brand presentation and a complete responsive website.

title: Adùn Kitchen
summary: A firewood kitchen concept with food-led editorial art direction, a filterable sample menu and a vivid sense of the table
built: Responsive React experience, menu exploration and concept visit preview.
